user.description: Select the iNet X panel to pair with.

pair.title: Pair {name}
pair.description:
Home Assistant has to be paired with the panel once.

1. Close the Truma iNet X app on phones and tablets nearby.
2. On the iNet X panel, start pairing a new Bluetooth device, as you would for the Truma app.
3. While the panel is waiting for a device, select **Submit**.

Pairing usually takes less than a minute.

progress.pairing: Pairing with {name}. Keep the panel in pairing mode until this step completes.

error.not_found: The panel was not found. Make sure it is switched on and in range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed. Start pairing mode on the panel again and retry.
error.no_response: The panel paired but did not answer. Close the Truma app on other devices and retry.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the log for details.

abort.no_devices_found: No iNet X panel is in range.
abort.not_supported: This device is not an iNet X panel.
